facts.fact: AfricaNenda states eKash, Rwanda's national instant payment system, launched in 2022 and by 2023 included commercial banks and mobile money participants supporting P2P, with a revamped version launched in February 2025.

AfricaNenda states all major players are connected to eKash, enabling P2P, P2M and P2B transactions between banks, mobile money providers, MFIs and SACCOs, processing 1.5 million transactions a month.
